name: hex-core
description: Hex Core — AI-native component library for LLMs and humans

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.description: Constrain children to a specific width-to-height ratio (e.g. 16/9 for video, 1/1 for square).

items.name: avatar
items.description: A user profile image with a fallback (usually initials) rendered when the image is missing or fails to load. Built on Radix UI Avatar — AvatarFallback accepts a delayMs prop to avoid flashing during fast loads.

items.name: badge
items.description: A small status indicator with multiple style variants. Used for tags, statuses, and categorization.

items.name: button
items.description: A versatile button component with multiple variants, sizes, and states. Supports icons, loading state, and composition via asChild.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: An accessible checkbox with checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states. Built on Radix UI.

items.name: cluster
items.description: Horizontal flex flow with wrap and token-bound gap. Use for tag lists, button rows, breadcrumbs, and any group of equally-weighted inline items.

items.name: container
items.description: Centered max-width wrapper that constrains content to readable widths. Sizes map to `--container-*` prose-width tokens; padding maps to `--space-*`.

items.name: empty
items.description: A zero-state surface for lists, dashboards, and search results with no content. Explains why the slot is empty + provides a call-to-action.

items.name: error-state
items.description: A surface for failed-fetch / failed-action states. Visually mirrors Empty but with destructive bias and an optional retry button. Mounts with role='alert' so screen readers announce on first render.

items.name: grid
items.description: CSS grid with column-count presets and token-bound gap. Pass `cols="auto-fit"` + `minColWidth` for responsive grids without media queries.

items.name: input
items.description: A styled text input with smooth focus transitions, shadow effects, and full HTML input compatibility.

items.name: label
items.description: An accessible label component built on Radix UI Label primitive. Associates with form controls via htmlFor.

items.name: loading
items.description: A composed loading-placeholder pattern for lists, cards, and stacks. Skeleton is the atom; Loading is the canonical molecule most surfaces want.

items.name: progress
items.description: A horizontal progress bar showing completion from 0 to 100%. Built on Radix UI Progress.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: A set of mutually exclusive radio options. Built on Radix UI RadioGroup with roving focus and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: A scrollable region with custom-styled scrollbars that match the design system. Content must be explicitly sized.

items.name: select
items.description: An accessible dropdown select for choosing one option from a list. Built on Radix UI Select with full keyboard navigation, typeahead, and RTL support.

items.name: separator
items.description: A visual divider between content sections with horizontal or vertical orientation.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder shown while content is loading. Pair with explicit dimensions.

items.name: slider
items.description: A range input with draggable thumbs. Supports single value, ranges (two thumbs), custom steps, and full keyboard control.

items.name: spacer
items.description: Declarative whitespace block bound to `--space-*` tokens. Use when sibling spacing can't come from a parent's `gap`.

items.name: stack
items.description: Vertical flex flow with token-bound gap. The headless equivalent of `<div className="flex flex-col gap-X">` with consistent spacing scale.

items.name: switch
items.description: An accessible toggle switch for instant on/off settings. Built on Radix UI.

items.name: tag
items.description: Interactive tag / chip primitive — Badge with an optional dismiss button. Mirrors Badge's variants so the visual sibling is obvious; ships with a close affordance for filter pills, multi-select selections, draft attachments.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A styled multi-line text input with smooth focus transitions and shadow effects.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A two-state button that stays pressed when toggled on. Used for formatting toolbars (bold/italic) or option toggles.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: A set of toggles where one or multiple can be pressed. Inherits Toggle's variant/size via context. Useful for alignment/formatting toolbars.

items.name: accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of collapsible content sections. Built on Radix UI Accordion.

items.name: alert
items.description: An inline notification banner for important messages. Supports default and destructive variants with optional leading icon.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A modal dialog for destructive confirmations. The user must explicitly accept or cancel — there is no close button. Built on Radix UI AlertDialog.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: A path trail showing the user's location within a hierarchy, with links back to ancestors and a non-interactive current page.

items.name: calendar
items.description: Date grid built on react-day-picker v9. Supports single, multiple, and range selection modes. Keyboard navigable and localizable.

items.name: card
items.description: A container component with header, content, and footer sections. Includes subtle shadow and hover effects.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: A single section that can be expanded or collapsed. For multiple independent sections use Accordion with type='multiple'.

items.name: color-picker
items.description: HSL-native color picker that edits an HSL triplet directly via three sliders (H/S/L). Hex input is a display adapter; sliders are the source of truth so the value round-trips losslessly through the `@hex-core/tokens` triplet format.

items.name: combobox
items.description: Searchable single-select input. Composes Popover + Command (cmdk) + a styled trigger. Pass a list of { value, label } options.

items.name: command
items.description: Composable command menu built on cmdk — search input + filtered list with keyboard navigation. Use as an inline palette or, wrapped in CommandDialog, as a ⌘K-style launcher.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: Right-click (or long-press on touch) menu anchored to the trigger region. Same item vocabulary as DropdownMenu.

items.name: data-table
items.description: Generic data-driven table built on TanStack Table + Hex Core Table primitives. Pass columns + data; add sorting/filtering/pagination via TanStack hooks.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: Date input composed from Popover + Calendar. Shows the selected date formatted via date-fns, opens a calendar grid on click.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content. Built on Radix UI with focus trap, escape handling, and scroll lock.

items.name: drawer
items.description: Bottom-sheet drawer built on vaul. Mobile-native feel: drag-to-dismiss, snap points, body-scale-on-open. Use for quick mobile actions, filters, pickers.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: A menu of actions displayed to the user when a trigger is activated. Supports items, checkboxes, radio groups, sub-menus, and keyboard shortcuts.

items.name: dropzone
items.description: Drag-and-drop file input built on the native HTML5 drag-drop API plus a visually-hidden <input type='file'> for keyboard + screen-reader access. Filters by accept/maxSize/maxFiles before emitting.

items.name: file-tree
items.description: Hierarchical tree view for files, folders, and any nested navigation. Implements the WAI-ARIA tree pattern with role='tree' / 'treeitem' / 'group', aria-level, aria-expanded, aria-selected, and full keyboard navigation (Up/Down/Left/Right/Home/End/Enter/Space).

items.name: form
items.description: A form primitive built on react-hook-form + zod. Provides Form/FormField/FormItem/FormLabel/FormControl/FormDescription/FormMessage with automatic aria wiring and error display.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: Rich floating content revealed on hover or focus. Use when Tooltip is too small and Popover requires a click.

items.name: input-otp
items.description: One-time-password / verification-code entry built on the input-otp library. Renders N character slots with active/caret state and auto-advance on type.

items.name: menubar
items.description: Desktop-app style menu bar (File / Edit / View). Horizontal menu strip with nested dropdowns.

items.name: multi-combobox
items.description: Searchable multi-select input. Composes Popover + Command (cmdk) + a styled trigger. Trigger shows '{n} selected'; each option exposes aria-selected.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.description: Website-style mega-menu with hover-triggered content panels. Used for marketing/site navigation headers.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Composable pagination controls (Pagination / PaginationContent / PaginationItem / PaginationLink / PaginationPrevious / PaginationNext / PaginationEllipsis). Link-based by default — pair with client-side navigation or server params.

items.name: popover
items.description: Floating content anchored to a trigger element. Non-modal by default — clicks outside dismiss it. Use for inline forms, info, or quick actions.

items.name: resizable
items.description: Draggable split panes built on react-resizable-panels v4. Horizontal or vertical, with keyboard-accessible handles and persistable layout.

items.name: sheet
items.description: Side drawer built on Radix Dialog with a directional slide animation. Use for navigation, filters, quick edit, or any off-canvas panel.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: App-shell sidebar with collapsible width, context-driven open state, and composable Header/Content/Footer/Item parts. Provider-based so any descendant can toggle it.

items.name: sonner
items.description: Ephemeral toast notifications via Sonner. Render <Toaster /> once at app root, then call toast() anywhere.

items.name: stepper
items.description: Linear progress indicator for multi-step flows (form wizards, onboarding, checkout). Pure semantic <ol>/<li> with aria-current='step' on the active step and a per-step error status override.

items.name: table
items.description: Styled HTML table primitives (Table / TableHeader / TableBody / TableRow / TableHead / TableCell / TableCaption / TableFooter). Low-level building blocks — use DataTable for sorting/filtering/pagination.

items.name: tabs
items.description: A tabbed interface with accessible keyboard navigation. Built on Radix UI Tabs.

items.name: time-picker
items.description: Time input — styled wrapper around the native <input type='time'>. Value is a 'HH:MM' (or 'HH:MM:SS' with step=1) string. The browser provides 12/24-hour locale handling, keyboard arrow spinning, and screen-reader announcement.

items.name: timeline
items.description: Vertical chronological event feed for activity logs, audit trails, release notes, and notification streams. Pure semantic <ol>/<li> with a status-colored indicator and an optional icon override.

items.name: toolbar
items.description: A horizontal or vertical group of related controls (buttons, toggles, links, separators) with arrow-key roving focus. Wraps Radix Toolbar so the keyboard semantics are correct out of the box.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: A small floating label that reveals on hover or focus. Wrap your app in TooltipProvider, then use Tooltip/TooltipTrigger/TooltipContent per tooltip.

items.name: tree
items.description: Generic hierarchical list with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation. Distinct from FileTree (which adds folder/file icon-by-extension logic) — Tree is content-agnostic for org charts, taxonomy pickers, navigation trees.

items.name: app-data-table
items.description: Page-level data-table view: a header row (title + description and a toolbar), a bordered table surface, and an optional footer for pagination. Layout only — supply the actual table as children. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: app-settings
items.description: Settings page layout: a stack of groups, each pairing a title + description column with a card of form controls (two columns on ≥lg, stacked below). Presentational and theme-driven — pass your own fields and submit handling.

items.name: app-shell
items.description: Application layout frame: a fixed left sidebar on ≥lg, a sticky top bar, and a scrollable main region. On mobile the sidebar collapses behind a menu button and slides in as an overlay drawer. Client Component. Theme-driven.

items.name: app-sidebar-nav
items.description: Sidebar navigation for AppShell: a pinned brand, a scrollable list of grouped links with active states and aria-current, and a pinned footer (account / sign-out). Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: app-stats
items.description: A row of KPI stat cards: label, value, and an optional colored delta with a directional caret (increase / decrease / neutral). Two, three, or four columns. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: auth-forgot-password
items.description: Single-field 'forgot password' page. On submit, dispatches a reset link via adapter.requestPasswordReset and swaps to an Empty-based 'check your inbox' confirmation state.

items.name: auth-reset-password
items.description: 'Set a new password' page paired with a reset link. Two fields (new password + confirm) with manual confirm-match validation; the opaque token is forwarded verbatim to adapter.resetPassword.

items.name: auth-sign-in-split
items.description: Split-screen sign-in page. Marketing panel on the left (≥lg), credential form on the right. Routes every credential / OAuth call through a consumer-supplied AuthAdapter.

items.name: auth-sign-up-card
items.description: Centered-card sign-up page. Email + password (with confirm) + optional name + terms checkbox + optional social providers. Routes account creation through a consumer-supplied AuthAdapter.

items.name: auth-verify-email
items.description: Transactional 'verify your email' page composed from the Empty primitive. Optional resend button calls adapter.resendMagicLink with a client-side cooldown timer; resend hides automatically when the adapter doesn't implement the method.

items.name: auth-verify-otp
items.description: One-time-code verification page. Renders an InputOTP of N slots and auto-submits when the code is full; routes verification through adapter.verifyOtp({ code, intent }). Optional resend button calls adapter.resendOtp.

items.name: commerce-cart
items.description: Shopping cart layout: a list of line items on the left and a sticky order summary on the right (stacked on mobile). Presentational and theme-driven — pass quantity steppers / remove buttons as per-item controls and the totals as summary.

items.name: commerce-checkout
items.description: Checkout layout: the form on the left and a sticky order summary on the right (stacked on mobile). Layout only — supply the form (contact, shipping, payment) as children and the order review as summary. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: commerce-product-detail
items.description: Product detail layout: imagery on the left, product info on the right (name, price, description, option controls, and add-to-cart actions), stacked on mobile. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: commerce-product-grid
items.description: A responsive product grid: an optional heading above a grid of product cards (image, name, optional meta, price). Cards link to a detail page when href is set. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: commerce-reviews
items.description: A product reviews section: a summary header (average rating + count) above a list of individual reviews, each with a star rating, author, optional date, and body. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: marketing-cta
items.description: A closing call-to-action band. 'simple' reads as centered copy on the page background; 'panel' lifts it into a primary-filled rounded card. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: marketing-feature-grid
items.description: A marketing feature grid: an optional heading block above a responsive grid of icon + title + description cells. Two- or three-column on desktop. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: marketing-footer
items.description: A marketing site footer: a brand block, several columns of links, and a bottom bar with social links and a copyright line. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: marketing-header
items.description: A marketing site header: brand mark, inline primary nav on desktop, and a collapsible panel on mobile. Client Component (owns the open/close state). Theme-driven.

items.name: marketing-hero
items.description: Top-of-page marketing hero. Eyebrow, headline, subcopy, CTA buttons, and an optional media slot. Centered single-column or split copy + media layout. Presentational and fully theme-driven.

items.name: marketing-logo-cloud
items.description: A row of customer / partner logos with an optional caption. Each logo is a caller-supplied ReactNode (img, inline SVG, or wordmark) — no image source is bundled. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: marketing-pricing
items.description: A pricing section: an optional heading block above a row of plan cards, with one tier highlightable as recommended. Each tier has a name, price, feature list, and a caller-supplied CTA. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: marketing-testimonial
items.description: A testimonials section. 'single' features one large centered quote; 'grid' lays out several quote cards with author + avatar. Presentational and theme-driven.

items.name: attachment
items.description: File / image thumbnail with optional remove affordance + upload-progress overlay. Composes with the AI Composer for multimodal message drafts. Auto-detects image vs file variant from MIME type + preview URL.

items.name: audio-player
items.description: Audio playback control backed by wavesurfer.js. Renders a play/pause button + linear waveform progress + duration. Pair with `<AudioWaveform>` for a standalone waveform display.

items.name: audio-waveform
items.description: Standalone audio waveform display backed by wavesurfer.js — for voice-message previews, audio thumbnails, recording indicators. No playback controls (use `<AudioPlayer>` for that).

items.name: branch
items.description: Headless alternate-response navigator. Renders one active branch with a prev/next control chip beneath it. Stateless — consumer owns `current` and `total`.

items.name: canvas
items.description: Headless node-graph canvas backed by reactflow. Renders interactive agent workflows, RAG graphs, document relationships. Default Background + Controls; slot for MiniMap or custom overlays.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.description: Structured ReAct-shape reasoning trace — each step has a thought, optional action, and optional observation. Final answer renders below the trace. Distinct from `<Reasoning>` (unstructured prose).

items.name: citation
items.description: Source attribution chip — renders a citation for a RAG hit, search result, or any external reference. Becomes a focusable link when url is provided.

items.name: code-block
items.description: Server-rendered, syntax-highlighted code block with a language-label header and a copy button. Dual-theme via Shiki — same HTML for light + dark.

items.name: composer
items.description: Multi-line input + submission shell for chat. Submits on Enter (Shift+Enter inserts newline). Trailing slot for attachment + send buttons.

items.name: conversation
items.description: High-level chat shell. Composes `<MessageList>` over a messages array, an optional `<Sources>` panel, an optional `<Shimmer>` placeholder during the dead-time before the first stream token, and a `<Composer>` row at the bottom.

items.name: diagram
items.description: Render a Mermaid diagram from a source string. For AI outputs that emit flowcharts / sequence / class diagrams — pipe the Markdown code-fence body straight in.

items.name: inline-citation
items.description: Inline footnote-style reference with a hover-preview popover. Pairs with Sources for the bottom-of-card list; fills the inline-text gap that the block Citation chip can't.

items.name: loading-indicator
items.description: Streaming/typing feedback with three motion variants — dots, pulse, bar.

items.name: markdown
items.description: Streaming-safe markdown renderer with AI-aware element slots. Native pipeline (react-markdown + remark-gfm + rehype-raw + rehype-sanitize) with slot wiring for fenced code, footnote citations, tool-call elements, and [!think] admonitions.

items.name: message
items.description: Single chat-message row scoped to one speaker (user / assistant / system / tool). Headless content slot — pair with Markdown, CodeBlock, or ToolCall children.

items.name: message-actions
items.description: Inline action-button row beneath a message — copy, regenerate, thumbs-up/down. Pure container; consumer supplies the buttons + handlers.

items.name: message-list
items.description: Auto-scrolling viewport for a chat stream. Pins to the bottom during streaming unless the user scrolls up to read history.

items.name: plan
items.description: Pre-execution multi-step plan card with an optional approval gate. Distinct from `<Task>` — Task is during/post-execution status; Plan is pre-execution intent.

items.name: reasoning
items.description: Collapsible thinking-trace block for Anthropic-style reasoning or chain-of-thought scratchpads. Optional duration in the header.

items.name: shimmer
items.description: Single-line streaming placeholder. Used during the dead-time between user submission and first stream token. Renders a motion-safe pulsing bar (Tailwind animate-pulse) that gates on `prefers-reduced-motion`.

items.name: sources
items.description: Bordered card listing 1–N citation chips for a RAG response. Re-uses Citation per row inside a Radix Collapsible so consumers can collapse the list when the response references many sources.

items.name: speech-recognition
items.description: Browser Web Speech API toggle button. Emits transcript chunks via callback; consumer keeps the text. Renders a disabled state when the browser doesn't support SpeechRecognition.

items.name: suggestion
items.description: Clickable prompt pill / quick-action chip. Forwards a payload to onSelect on click.

items.name: task
items.description: Multi-step task progress card. Each step's state re-uses the canonical ToolCallState vocabulary; the header tracks aggregate progress.

items.name: terminal
items.description: Headless terminal display backed by xterm.js. Consumer owns the data flow — pass `output` to display, receive typed bytes via `onInput`. No PTY, no shell.

items.name: tool-call
items.description: Collapsible card showing a tool/function invocation — name, lifecycle state badge, expandable args + result body.

items.name: arc
items.description: Arc diagram. Nodes lie on a horizontal baseline; relationships are drawn as semicircle arcs above. Pure SVG; no heavy peer dep. Use when node ORDER matters (sequence, time, story position).

items.name: chord
items.description: Chord diagram. Nodes sit on a ring; ribbons inside encode weighted bidirectional relationships. Use for trade flows, migration, citation networks — "A relates to B with weight w" at scale.

items.name: cloze
items.description: Cloze-deletion text — sentences with redacted spans the learner reveals one at a time (or all at once). Pure HTML; no heavy peer.

items.name: compare-table
items.description: Side-by-side comparison table. Subjects are columns; attributes are rows; cells render the per-subject value for each attribute. Optional difference highlighting flags cells that diverge from the row's reference. Pure HTML; no heavy peer.

items.name: deck
items.description: Paged sequence of flashcards with optional shuffle, prev/next navigation, a progress bar, and a render slot for per-card SRS rating. Composes Flashcard internally.

items.name: dendrogram
items.description: Clustering tree where every leaf sits at the same depth, regardless of branch length — the visual signature of taxonomies, phylogenetic trees, and hierarchical-clustering output.

items.name: flashcard
items.description: Front/back card with a 3D flip animation on click. Pure CSS 3D transform; no animation peer. Headless on content — front and back accept any ReactNode. Pairs with Deck for session-level paging and SpacedRepetition for confidence rating.

items.name: flowchart
items.description: Typed React flowchart. Pass nodes (with optional shape) and directional edges; the component runs a topological-rank auto-layout and renders top-to-bottom or left-to-right. Pure SVG; no heavy peer dep.

items.name: funnel
items.description: Conversion funnel — vertical stack of trapezoidal stages whose width is proportional to each stage's value. Pure SVG; no heavy peer dep.

items.name: gantt
items.description: Gantt chart — tasks as horizontal bars across a time axis with optional dependency arrows and progress fills. Pure SVG; no heavy peer dep.

items.name: image-occlusion
items.description: Image with rectangular regions hidden behind opaque overlays. Click any region to reveal what's underneath. Pure HTML; no heavy peer. Coordinates are 0–1 fractions so the layout stays correct at any rendered size.

items.name: matrix
items.description: Adjacency-matrix diagram. Square grid where cell color intensity encodes the relationship from row to column. Pure SVG; no heavy peer dep. Best for dense graphs that turn into hairballs in node-link form.

items.name: mind-map
items.description: Typed React mind map. Pass a hierarchical root node and the component lays children out radially (or horizontally) using d3-hierarchy's tree layout — no Mermaid string DSL required.

items.name: org-chart
items.description: Top-down organizational chart with collapsible subtrees. Each node renders as a rounded card showing label + subtitle; click any node with children to fold its subtree behind a +N badge.

items.name: pyramid
items.description: Ranked-tier pyramid. Tiers stack top-to-bottom; widths can grow toward the base (widening) or shrink (narrowing). Pure SVG; no heavy peer dep. Distinct from Funnel — Pyramid encodes RANK, Funnel encodes FLOW.

items.name: quiz
items.description: Single-question multiple-choice quiz with submit + reveal. After submit, each option is tagged data-state="correct|incorrect|missed" so consumers can theme right / wrong / unselected-but-correct independently. Pure HTML; no heavy peer.

items.name: sankey
items.description: Weighted-flow diagram. Nodes arranged in horizontal columns by topological depth; link thickness encodes flow value. Use for funnels, energy/material/money flows, and any "value moving from A to B" picture.

items.name: sequence
items.description: UML-style sequence diagram. Actors as columns with vertical lifelines; messages as horizontal arrows in declaration order. Pure SVG; no heavy peer dep.

items.name: spaced-repetition
items.description: Anki-style confidence rating row — four buttons (Again / Hard / Good / Easy) that emit a rating signal. Headless on scheduling: consumers wire SM-2, FSRS, or any other algorithm; this primitive just captures the learner's signal.

items.name: sunburst
items.description: Radial hierarchy by value. Each ring is a deeper level of the tree; segment angles are proportional to summed values. Click a segment to drill in; click the center to zoom out.

items.name: time-axis
items.description: Events plotted along a horizontal time axis. Pure SVG; no heavy peer dep. Distinct from the existing event-list `<Timeline>` — TimeAxis encodes elapsed time as horizontal distance, so the *gap between events* is the message.

items.name: tree-map
items.description: Nested rectangles sized by value — each leaf's area is proportional to its `value`. Squarified by default for legibility.

items.name: venn
items.description: Set-overlap diagram for 2 or 3 sets. Pure SVG; no heavy peer dep. Shows categorical overlap (which sets intersect) — NOT exact intersection cardinality (use an Euler-diagram solver for that).

items.name: blur-in
items.description: CSS filter:blur(N) → blur(0) wrapper. Adds a focus-pull aesthetic to entrance moments. Filter is the only non-compositor-friendly prop the engine animates by design — keep blur radii small (≤16px) to stay GPU-accelerated.

items.name: bounce
items.description: Mount-time overshoot bounce. Scale 0.7 → (1 + intensity) → 1 with synced opacity fade. Different from <Pulse> (continuous) and <ScaleIn> (no overshoot) — Bounce is for items landing into a layout with personality.

items.name: clip
items.description: A single animation segment inside a Timeline/Scene. Targets a CSS selector and animates from `from` → `to` over `duration`. Renders nothing.

items.name: count-up
items.description: Numeric tween — animates a number from `from` to `to` over `duration` using the active MotionConfig clock. Pluggable formatter for currency, percent, compact units.

items.name: fade-in
items.description: Mount-time opacity 0 → 1 wrapper. Thinnest possible Motion.div invocation; same engine, same prefers-reduced-motion behavior, same easing tokens. Use as a building block for any fade.

items.name: marquee
items.description: Infinite-scrolling track with seamless wrap. Duplicates children once; translates the inner track so the seam stays invisible. Pauses on hover by default so users can read.

items.name: motion-pro
items.description: Optional adapter that wraps `motion@^11`'s React API. Use only when the zero-dep core can't cover the need (layout/FLIP, drag gestures, shared-element transitions). Imported from `@hex-core/motion/adapters/motion`.

items.name: motion-timeline
items.description: Deterministic scene composer for multi-step UI sequences. Imported from `@hex-core/motion/timeline`. NOT for video export — no FFmpeg, no MP4. Children are <Scene> and <Clip>. Slug is `motion-timeline` to avoid colliding with the existing chronological-event `timeline` component.

items.name: motion
items.description: Declarative React animation factory. Use Motion.div / Motion.span / Motion.button / etc. with `initial`, `animate`, `exit`, `transition`, `whileHover`, `whileTap` props. Powered by the WAAPI engine; no peer deps.

items.name: page-transition
items.description: Wraps the current page tree in a keyed Motion.div inside Presence — adds enter/exit transitions for client-side route changes. Caller passes `pageKey` (typically the pathname) so React can tell old vs new routes apart.

items.name: parallax
items.description: Translates its child with the page scroll position. Subscribes to useScroll().scrollYProgress so displacement scales between 0 and `offset` across the document height. Lighter than per-element parallax; covers the headline-on-hero use case.

items.name: presence
items.description: Defers child unmount until the child's `exit` animation completes. Tracks children by `key`; works with any Motion.* element.

items.name: pulse
items.description: Infinite scale pulse for attention-seeking UI: notification dots, hint buttons before first interaction, beating CTA hearts. Honors prefers-reduced-motion (animation never starts when reduce is active).

items.name: reveal-on-scroll
items.description: Animates children from a hidden state to a fully revealed one when they first enter the viewport. Built on useInView; defaults to fade + slide-up — the most common 'scroll reveal' pattern.

items.name: scale-in
items.description: Mount-time scale-up wrapper. Default 0.95 → 1 with a synced opacity fade gives modals, toasts, and primary CTAs a deliberate landing.

items.name: scene
items.description: A time window inside a Timeline. Children's Clip `start` props are interpreted relative to this scene's `start`. Renders no DOM — purely defines the time context.

items.name: shake
items.description: Shake-on-trigger primitive — typical use is form-error feedback. Pass a `trigger` value that bumps when you want the shake to fire (an error count, a timestamp). 5-keyframe horizontal jitter.

items.name: shine
items.description: Skeleton loader gradient sweep. A translucent highlight band travels left to right across the host. Pair with <Skeleton> + bg-muted for the standard loading affordance. (Named `shine` to avoid colliding with the AI `shimmer` streaming-text effect.)

items.name: slide-in
items.description: Mount-time slide from a chosen edge with optional fade. Direction-aware Motion.div wrapper. Most popular pattern for hero subheadings and modal entrance.

items.name: stagger
items.description: Cascades the delays of motion-aware children. Each child receives an injected `transition.delay = initialDelay + index * gap`. Existing per-child delays are preserved (consumer intent wins on top of the cascade).

items.name: track
items.description: Optional grouping for parallel clips on a named track (e.g. `<Track name="opacity">`). Tracks are a labeling/inspection convenience; they don't affect playback ordering.

items.name: transition
items.description: Token-aware easing/duration object. Accepts named easings (standard, emphasized, decelerate, accelerate, bounce) so motion stays consistent across primitives even when themes change.

items.name: typewriter
items.description: Reveals text character-by-character using the active MotionConfig clock. Doesn't go through the WAAPI driver (the animation is text content, not a CSS property). Optional blinking cursor while typing.

items.name: use-animate
items.description: Imperative animate hook. Returns `[scope, animate]` — `scope` is a ref to attach to a wrapper, `animate(target, to, transition)` runs an animation and returns a controllable handle with a `finished` Promise.

items.name: use-scroll
items.description: Subscribable motion values for window scroll position and progress. Returns `{ scrollY, scrollYProgress }`. Read with `useMotionValueRender(value)` or wire directly into a Motion animation.

items.name: variants
items.description: Named-state map for orchestrating multi-state animations. Pass strings to Motion.* `initial`/`animate` to switch between states declaratively.
